chapter.heading: An Earnest Appeal for Guidance and DeliveranceA Psalm of David.
chapter.v:
Hear my
prayer, O Lord,Give ear to my supplications!In Your faithfulness answer me,And in Your righteousness. [Jer. 27:20]

Do not
enter into judgment with Your servant,For in Your sight no one living is righteous. [2 Kin. 24:12- 16; 2 Chr. 36:9, 10; Jer. 22:24-28 c 2 Kin. 24:12, 15; Jer. 13:18 2 Kin. 24:12; 2 Chr.]

For the
enemy has persecuted my soul;He has crushed my life to the ground;He has made me dwell in darkness,Like those who have long been dead. [2 Chr. 34:8]

Therefore my
spirit is overwhelmed within me;My heart within me is distressed.

I remember
the days of old;I meditate on all Your works;I muse on the work of Your hands.

I spread
out my hands to You;My soul longs for You like a thirsty land.Selah

Answer me
speedily, O Lord;My spirit fails!Do not hide Your face from me,Lest I be like those who go down into the pit. [Ezra 6:10; Neh. 1:4-11; Dan. 9:16; 1 Tim. 2:2]

Cause me
to hear Your lovingkindness in the morning,For in You do I trust;Cause me to know the way in which I should walk,For I lift up my soul to You. [Jer. 14:14; Eph. 5:6]

Deliver me,
O Lord, from my enemies;In You I take shelter. [Jer. 28:15; 37:19]

Teach me
to do Your will,For You are my God;Your Spirit is good.Lead me in the land of uprightness. [2 Chr. 36:21- 23; Ezra 1:1-4; Jer. 25:12; 27:22; Dan. 9:2; Zech. 7:5 i [Jer. 24:6, 7]; Zeph. 2:7]

Revive me,
O Lord, for Your name’s sake!For Your righteousness’ sake bring my soul out of trouble.

In Your
mercy cut off my enemies,And destroy all those who afflict my soul;For I am Your servant. [Ps. 50:15; Jer. 33:3; Dan. 9:3 k Ps.]
